title: Junior Drafter
location: Melbourne, Victoria, Australia | On-Site | Full Time (office: 9 Queens Ave, Hawthorn VIC 3122)
content_text:
Junior Drafter
 Melbourne, Victoria, Australia | On-Site | Full Time
We are seeking a Junior Drafter to support our engineering and environmental teams in Melbourne (VIC). This role suits someone early in their drafting career who has a strong eye for detail and wants to develop their CAD skills in a technical consultancy. You will work closely with and report to our Senior Drafter, preparing drawings for landfill, gas management and site remediation projects.
What you will do
Prepare 2D and 3D CAD drawings for environmental engineering projects, including landfill design, gas management systems, sample location plans and site remediation works
Assist the Senior Drafter with design layouts, infrastructure drawings and as-built documentation
Update and revise drawings in response to feedback from the Senior Drafter, engineers and scientists
Maintain drawing registers, revision histories and document control records
Apply Core-EP CAD templates and drafting standards consistently across projects
Work with engineers and scientists to understand technical briefs and site information
What we are looking for
Certificate III or IV in Drafting, Engineering or a related discipline, or currently studying towards one
Working knowledge of AutoCAD, with Civil 3D experience or a willingness to learn it
Strong attention to detail and accuracy
Good organisation skills and the ability to manage multiple drawing tasks
Clear communication skills and openness to feedback
Proactive, motivated and keen to learn in a technical consultancy environment
Interest in environmental engineering, civil or infrastructure drafting (desirable)
Why join us
We believe in more than just a job – we offer a place to grow, connect, and make a real impact.
Grow With Us: Your development matters. We invest in your skills, support your career goals, and back you with opportunities to take on meaningful, challenging projects.
Be Yourself: Our team is made stronger by the diverse voices and backgrounds that shape it. We foster a culture of inclusion, collaboration, and mutual respect.
Make a Difference: Whether it’s helping clients, supporting communities, or tackling environmental challenges, your work here creates lasting, positive change – and we’ll encourage your ideas along the way.
Live Well: We get that life isn’t all about work. That’s why we offer flexibility, team social events, rostered days off, benefits, and a team that supports you every step of the way.
If you are interested, please send an introductory letter with your updated CV to aditiagarwal@core-ep.com.au.
